description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

description.zh: 是否自动续费。仅当付费类型为`PrePaid`时，该参数才生效且为可选参数。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter applies only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.
> This parameter is not publicly available.
The billing method of the cloud drive.

description.zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络的云企业网实例ID。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写。
description.en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. This parameter is required when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR` and you do not specify `OfficeSiteId`.

description.zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络对应的域控名称。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写。
description.en: The name of the domain controller. This parameter is required when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR` and you do not specify `OfficeSiteId`.

description.zh:
网盘存储空间最大峰值。

- 创建按量付费网盘时，单位为Byte（字节）。
- 创建预付费网盘时，单位为GiB。例如，如需创建500GiB的预付费网盘，则填写500；如需创建2TiB的预付费网盘，则填写2048。
description.en:
The total capacity of the cloud drive.

- For pay-as-you-go cloud drives, the unit is bytes.

- For subscription cloud drives, the unit is GiB. For example, set the value to 500 for 500 GiB, or to 2048 for 2 TiB.
The name of the cloud drive.

description.zh: 办公网络ID，当办公网络类型为`AD_CONNECTOR`时有效。
description.en: The ID of the office site. This parameter applies only when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR`.
The type of the office site.

description.zh: 购买资源的时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。
description.en: The subscription duration. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

description.zh: 预付费网盘的购买时长单位。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。
description.en: The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.
> This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh: 预付费网盘的用户数量限额。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。
description.en: The maximum number of users for a subscription cloud drive. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

description.zh: 分配用户个人盘时，个人盘的存储峰值。单位：Byte（字节）。
description.en: The maximum size of the personal disk for each user, in bytes.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解企业网盘的收费方式和价格。详细信息请参见[企业网盘概述](~~386301~~)。
descriptions.en: Before using this interface, make sure you understand the billing methods and pricing of Drive and Photo Service. For more information, see [Overview of Drive and Photo Service](~~386301~~).
